scope: Read-only post-hoc audit of 22 original development BVH windows, 66 controlled exports and existing K1/K2 fits; no IK rerun, tuning or final holdout reuse

definitions.R: Original BVH positions in metres, Y-up, before filtering/retargeting; original window reconstructed from manifest
definitions.D: Saved serialized degraded input decoded to common joint positions; includes temporal, rig and codec losses
definitions.F: Saved model plus filtered coordinates, evaluated by FK at final 100 Hz clock
definitions.timing: Same physical times and common finite mask for R/D/K1/K2; interpolate positions, then derive angles; no new smoothing or alignment
definitions.position: Absolute world-space wrist positions; target-body shape changes included; no scale normalization
definitions.reference_quality: Published BVH geometric reference; external anatomical accuracy not established
definitions.summary: Within each record use worse-side P95; average records equally. Signed scalar errors add on identical frames; norms and percentiles do not.
